title: Add OTLP Telemetry Export
author: jdbohrman
lessons: OpenTelemetry's global tracer registration is a footgun in VS Code extensions -- all extensions share a process, so register() creates cross-extension conflicts
Telemetry clients inheriting from a base class still need per-client privacy filtering -- defaults allow everything
VS Code's globalState is not encrypted -- use SecretStorage for API keys and auth tokens
Lock file @types/node churn reveals environment inconsistency between contributor and project
Even opt-in features need test coverage -- span lifecycle bugs and reconfiguration races are real risks
